segments.en: Hello everyone, welcome to EnglishPod.
segments.zh: 大家好，欢迎来到Englishpod。

segments.en: My name is Marco.

segments.zh: 我的名字是凯瑟琳，今天我们谈论的是我很久没有真正见过的东西，但在美国很常见，尤其是在郊区。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: We're going to get a subscription as the title of the lesson says.

segments.en: Good afternoon, ma'am.
segments.zh: 下午好，女士。

segments.en: My name is Mike and I'm selling subscriptions to all sorts of periodicals.
segments.zh: 我的名字是 Mike，我正在销售各种期刊的订阅。

segments.en: No, thank you.
segments.zh: 不用了，谢谢。

segments.en: I'm not interested.
segments.zh: 我没兴趣。

segments.en: Please, ma'am, if you could spare five minutes of your time, I'm sure we could find something that could interest you.
segments.zh: 拜托，女士，如果你能抽出五分钟的时间，我相信我们能找到你感兴趣的东西。

segments.en: I wish I could, but I have to walk the dog and finish cooking.
segments.zh: 我也想听听，但我还得遛狗、把饭做完。

segments.en: So if you'd excuse me.
segments.zh: 所以，不好意思，我得忙去了。

segments.en: We have a great variety of magazines all about cooking.
segments.zh: 我们有很多关于烹饪的杂志。

segments.en: This one, for example, is a bi-monthly publication with recipes from all over the world.
segments.zh: 例如，这是一份双月刊出版物，其中包含来自世界各地的食谱。

segments.en: Wow.

segments.en: Well, that would be kind of useful.
segments.zh: 好吧，那会很有用。

segments.en: Do you have any other cooking magazines?

segments.en: Sure do.
segments.zh: 当然有。

segments.en: This one is a quarterly publication, but each issue has over 200 colored pages of recipes and also many home decorating ideas.
segments.zh: 这一篇是季度出版物，但每期都有 200 多页彩页的食谱和许多家居装饰理念。

segments.en: Wow, this is nice.
segments.zh: 哇，真不错。

segments.en: Okay, sign me up for both publications.
segments.zh: 好，那这两份刊物都给我订上。

segments.en: Most pet owners sign up for this weekly newsletter that has information on dog care, pet shops, and even pet sitters.
segments.zh: 大多数养宠物的人都会订阅这份每周通讯，里面有养狗知识、宠物商店信息，甚至还有宠物代看服务的信息。

segments.en: That's exactly what I needed.
segments.zh: 这正是我所需要的。

segments.en: What else do you have?
segments.zh: 你还有什么？

segments.en: Well, I also have...
segments.zh: 嗯，我还有……

segments.en: All right, we're back.
segments.zh: 好了，我们回来了。

segments.en: So as you saw, Mike is, well, not very excited to be selling subscriptions, but he has magazines about almost everything, I think.
segments.zh: 所以正如你所看到的，迈克对销售订阅感到不是很兴奋，但我认为他几乎所有的杂志都有杂志。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: And he's actually a pretty good salesperson because it sounds like this customer is going to buy quite a few magazines.
segments.zh: 而且他实际上是一个很好的销售人员，因为听起来这个客户会买很多杂志。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: And so he used a lot of interesting vocabulary related to magazines and subscriptions.
segments.zh: 所以他使用了很多与杂志和订阅相关的有趣词汇。

segments.en: Okay, so this first word is one that we've already said a couple of times in today's lesson.
segments.zh: 好的，所以第一个词是我们在今天的课程中已经说过几次的话。

segments.en: This is the topic of the lesson.
segments.zh: 这是本课的主题。

segments.en: The word is subscription.
segments.zh: 这个词是订阅。

segments.en: Okay, so if you get a subscription, that means that you are paying money to receive something every month, every week, etc.
segments.zh: 好的，所以如果您获得订阅，这意味着您每个月、每周等都付钱接收东西。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So the time is fixed.
segments.zh: 所以时间是固定的。

segments.en: Like you said, it could be weekly, the time could change.
segments.zh: 就像你说的，它可能是每周一次，时间可能会改变。

segments.en: But basically, you have a promise that after you pay this money, you'll receive something periodically.
segments.zh: 但基本上，你有一个承诺，在你支付这笔钱后，你会定期收到一些东西。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: And so there are many things that you could have a subscription for, not just magazines.
segments.zh: 所以有很多东西可以订阅，而不仅仅是杂志。

segments.en: Newspapers come in subscriptions.
segments.zh: 报纸订阅。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: Or maybe you pay for satellite TV.
segments.zh: 或者，也许您为卫星电视付费。

segments.en: That's a subscription.
segments.zh: 那是订阅。

segments.en: You pay every month and you receive channels, like lots of channels.
segments.zh: 您每个月都付款并收到频道，例如许多频道。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: Or hopefully, EnglishPod, you receive by subscription or you pay the subscription fee.
segments.zh: 或者希望，EnglishPod，您通过订阅或支付订阅费获得。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: So with EnglishPod, you subscribe.
segments.zh: 因此，使用 EnglishPod，您订阅。

segments.en: That would be the verb.
segments.zh: 那将是动词。

segments.en: A subscription is the noun.
segments.zh: 订阅是名词。

segments.en: You subscribe to a service like a newspaper magazine and you receive the magazine or the service every month, every week, every day, depending on what the subscription is like.
segments.zh: 您订阅报纸杂志之类的服务，您每个月、每周、每天都会收到该杂志或服务，具体取决于订阅情况。

segments.en: Okay, and so because subscriptions come at different time frames, so for example, EnglishPod, we have lessons three times a week.
segments.zh: 好的，所以因为订阅时间不同，例如，EnglishPod，我们每周有 3 次课程。

segments.en: Newspapers are oftentimes every day.
segments.zh: 报纸通常是每天。

segments.en: They come in different periods of time.
segments.zh: 它们出现在不同的时间段内。

segments.en: So we call these kinds of publications periodicals.
segments.zh: 所以我们把这类出版物称为期刊。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So for example, as you said, a newspaper, it comes every day.
segments.zh: 例如，正如你所说，报纸，它每天都来。

segments.en: That's the period of time.
segments.zh: 那是一段时间。

segments.en: So it's a periodical.
segments.zh: 所以这是期刊。

segments.en: The same as a magazine.
segments.zh: 和杂志一样。

segments.en: Sometimes they are weekly.
segments.zh: 有时他们是每周一次。

segments.en: Sometimes they are monthly.
segments.zh: 有时它们是每月一次。

segments.en: Is a book a periodical, Pop Quiz?
segments.zh: 一本书是期刊，流行测验吗？

segments.en: No.
segments.zh: 不。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: No, because you only get it once.
segments.zh: 不，因为你只得到一次。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So basically, a periodical has to be something, I guess, that comes out every so often, a new version, a new edition.
segments.zh: 所以基本上，期刊必须是经常出现的东西，一个新版本，一个新版本。

segments.en: It's continually updating.
segments.zh: 它在不断更新。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So that is periodicals and subscriptions.
segments.zh: 所以这是期刊和订阅。

segments.en: Now moving on to when he was trying to sell the magazines, he said, we have a great variety of magazines all about cooking.
segments.zh: 接下来，说到他推销杂志的时候，他说：我们有各种各样的烹饪杂志。

segments.en: So what is a variety?
segments.zh: 那么什么是多样性？

segments.en: Variety is a great word.
segments.zh: 多样性是一个很好的词。

segments.en: It's a word I personally am a very big fan of.
segments.zh: 这是我个人非常喜欢的一个词。

segments.en: I like to have many choices to choose from.
segments.zh: 我喜欢有很多选择可供选择。

segments.en: So variety means something that has many options.
segments.zh: 所以多样性意味着有很多选择的东西。

segments.en: For example, at the grocery store, there's a great variety of food.
segments.zh: 例如，在杂货店，有各种各样的食物。

segments.en: There are apples and crackers and cakes and wine.
segments.zh: 有苹果、饼干、蛋糕和酒。

segments.en: So variety means there are many different kinds of something.
segments.zh: 所以多样性意味着有许多不同类型的东西。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So many choices.
segments.zh: 这么多选择。

segments.en: At the bookstore, you can find a variety of books and magazines, for example.
segments.zh: 例如，在书店，您可以找到各种书籍和杂志。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: Now moving on to, again, when we're talking about the period of time, how often she's going to get this cooking magazine, the one that he's showing her is a bi-monthly publication.
segments.zh: 现在再说一遍，当我们谈论时间段时，她多久会得到这本烹饪杂志，他向她展示的是一份双月刊。

segments.en: So what exactly does it mean if she receives a magazine bi-monthly?
segments.zh: 那么，如果她每两个月收到一本杂志，这究竟意味着什么呢？

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So this is a bit confusing in English.
segments.zh: 所以这在英语中有点令人困惑。

segments.en: Bi-monthly has two meanings, but what's important is the word bi- here or the prefix bi-.
segments.zh: Bi-monthly 有两个含义，但这里重要的是 bi- 这个词，也就是前缀 bi-。

segments.en: That means two.
segments.zh: 这意味着两个。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So we could say bi-monthly, bi-weekly, bi-annually.
segments.zh: 所以我们可以说每两月一次，每两周一次，每两年一次。

segments.en: These all mean two.
segments.zh: 这些都意味着两个。

segments.en: So in this case, we're talking about something that I receive two times every month.
segments.zh: 所以在这种情况下，我们谈论的是我每个月都会收到两次的东西。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: Or it can be that you get it once every two months.
segments.zh: 或者你可以每两个月拿到一次。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So that might be confusing.
segments.zh: 所以这可能会令人困惑。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So let's just say that it's the month of October and I have this great subscription to a magazine.
segments.zh: 所以让我们说现在是十月，我对一本杂志有了很好的订阅。

segments.en: So in October, I will receive it two times.
segments.zh: 所以在十月，我会收到两次。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: So you get it twice.
segments.zh: 所以你得到它两次。

segments.en: Or it could also mean that you receive the magazine in October and then you don't receive another magazine until December.
segments.zh: 或者这也可能意味着您在 10 月收到该杂志，然后直到 12 月才收到另一本杂志。

segments.en: So it's a bi-monthly publication.
segments.zh: 所以这是一个双月刊。

segments.en: Every other month.
segments.zh: 每隔一个月。

segments.en: Every two months.
segments.zh: 每两个月。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So this is very confusing for us.
segments.zh: 所以这对我们来说非常令人困惑。

segments.en: It's confusing for you, but if you see this word bi-monthly or bi-weekly, you should ask the person who's offering the subscription what kind they mean.
segments.zh: 它确实容易让人困惑，但如果你看到 bi-monthly 或 bi-weekly 这个词，应该问问提供订阅的人，他们指的是哪种意思。

segments.en: Is it every month two times or is it every other month?
segments.zh: 是每月两次还是每月一次？

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So exactly.
segments.zh: 对，正是如此。

segments.en: Just remember the prefix bi- means two.
segments.zh: 只要记住前缀 bi- 意思是 2。

segments.en: And then if it's bi-monthly, bi-annual, bi-weekly, you have to more or less make sure that they specify what they mean because it can mean both.
segments.zh: 然后，如果是 bi-monthly、bi-annual、bi-weekly，你多少得确认他们说的到底是哪种意思，因为它可能两种含义都有。

segments.en: And that's how ambiguous this word is.
segments.zh: 这就是这个词的模棱两可。

segments.en: It is.
segments.zh: 确实有歧义。

segments.en: So the next one, the next word we have for you is not nearly as confusing.
segments.zh: 所以下一个，我们为您准备的下一个词并没有那么令人困惑。

segments.en: It's a very, very common word in both periodicals and sales, but also in marketing and business as well.
segments.zh: 这在期刊和销售中都是一个非常非常常见的词，在营销和商业中也是如此。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: We're talking about a quarterly publication or something that comes out once every quarter.
segments.zh: 我们谈论的是季度出版物或每季度出版一次的内容。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So if you think about a year, a year has 12 months.
segments.zh: 所以如果你想想一年，一年有 12 个月。

segments.en: A quarter of a year is three months.
segments.zh: 一年的四分之一是三个月。

segments.en: So the first quarter is January, February, March.
segments.zh: 所以第一季度是一月、二月、三月。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: So a quarterly publication means that you will get a magazine four times in one year.
segments.zh: 因此，季度出版物意味着您将在一年内获得四次杂志。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: We could also talk about quarterly sales.
segments.zh: 我们也可以谈论季度销售。

segments.en: You know, this quarter our business did very well, but last quarter was not so good.
segments.zh: 你知道，本季度我们的业务做得很好，但上个季度不太好。

segments.en: So quarter means three months at a time.
segments.zh: 所以四分之一意味着一次三个月。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: And for our last word on language takeaway today, we are talking about a weekly newsletter.
segments.zh: 今天我们语言要点的最后一个词是每周的时事通讯。

segments.en: So weekly is pretty straightforward.
segments.zh: 所以每周都很简单。

segments.en: You receive it once every week.
segments.zh: 你每周收到一次。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So weekly publications are very common.
segments.zh: 所以每周出版物很常见。

segments.en: What is a newsletter?
segments.zh: 什么是时事通讯？

segments.en: A newsletter is important in periodicals because it's not a magazine, but it's not a letter either.
segments.zh: 时事通讯在期刊中很重要，因为它不是杂志，但也不是一封信。

segments.en: It's basically a short update, a couple of pages maybe, or even one page that's on a piece of paper that gives you information about a group or a club or a community.
segments.zh: 它基本上是一个简短的更新，可能是几页，甚至是一张纸上的一页，可以为您提供有关团体、俱乐部或社区的信息。

segments.en: For example, we could say the EnglishPod newsletter comes out quarterly.
segments.zh: 例如，我们可以说 Englishpod 时事通讯每季度发布一次。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: Maybe in your offices you receive your company's newsletter.
segments.zh: 也许在您的办公室中，您会收到公司的时事通讯。

segments.en: So usually some companies will come out with a monthly or a quarterly newsletter where if you have many offices or many branches all over the country or the world, then you will receive updates or news about what's going on in other places within your same company.
segments.zh: 因此，通常有些公司会发布每月或季度的时事通讯，如果您在全国或世界各地有许多办事处或许多分支机构，那么您将收到有关同一公司其他地方正在发生的事情的更新或新闻。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So these are very useful for communication across the company.
segments.zh: 因此，这些对于整个公司的沟通非常有用。

segments.en: You can tell some people in your New York office that in Los Angeles we have a new cafeteria or a new employee.
segments.zh: 你可以告诉你纽约办公室的一些人，在洛杉矶，我们有一个新的自助餐厅或一个新员工。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: So that is what a newsletter is basically for.
segments.zh: 所以这就是时事通讯的主要用途。

segments.zh: 嗯，我还有……

segments.en: All right, so now we have some sentences or ways that you can say things on Fluency Builder.
segments.zh: 好，接下来在流利表达环节，我们准备了一些句子和说法。

segments.en: Fluency Builder.
segments.zh: 流利表达。

segments.en: Okay, this first phrase is very, very common among sales and sales people because basically it's a way to be polite and to ask someone to listen to you for a little while.
segments.zh: 好吧，这第一个短语在销售和销售人员中非常非常普遍，因为基本上这是一种礼貌并要求某人听你一会儿的方式。

segments.en: The salesperson says, if you could spare five minutes of your time.
segments.zh: 销售人员说，如果你能抽出五分钟的时间。

segments.en: Okay, so let's start with that part.
segments.zh: 好的，让我们从那部分开始。

segments.en: If you could spare.
segments.zh: 如果你能腾出一点时间。

segments.en: So to spare something means do you have something extra?
segments.zh: 所以 spare 某样东西，意思是你有多余的吗？

segments.en: Do you have enough of it?
segments.zh: 你够用吗？

segments.en: Yeah, so I could say, can you spare $5?
segments.zh: 是的，所以我可以问：你能匀出 5 美元吗？

segments.en: I forgot my wallet at home.
segments.zh: 我把钱包忘在家里了。

segments.en: So that means do you have an extra $5 I could borrow?
segments.zh: 所以这意味着你有额外的 5 美元我可以借吗？

segments.en: Okay, very good.
segments.zh: 好，很好。

segments.en: So if you're asking someone to spare five minutes of their time, you're asking them to give you five minutes of their time.
segments.zh: 因此，如果您要求某人抽出五分钟的时间，您就是在要求他们给您五分钟的时间。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So if you could spare a second or if you could spare five minutes of your time, I would like to talk to you.
segments.zh: 因此，如果您可以腾出一秒钟的时间，或者如果您可以抽出五分钟的时间，我想与您交谈。

segments.en: Okay, so it's a very polite way to ask someone for their time.
segments.zh: 好的，所以这是一种非常有礼貌的方式来询问某人的时间。

segments.en: Now for our next phrase, the woman is also very polite.
segments.zh: 现在对于我们的下一个短语，女人也很有礼貌。

segments.en: She says, you know what?
segments.zh: 她说，你知道吗？

segments.en: I have to walk the dog.
segments.zh: 我必须遛狗。

segments.en: I have to finish cooking.
segments.zh: 我必须完成烹饪。

segments.en: So if you would excuse me.
segments.zh: 所以，恕我失陪。

segments.en: She's basically saying no in a very polite way.
segments.zh: 她基本上是以非常礼貌的方式拒绝。

segments.en: If you could excuse me, I've got to go.
segments.zh: 恕我失陪，我得走了。

segments.en: So this is a kind of a very indirect but polite way of saying, I'm sorry, I can't stay.
segments.zh: 所以这是一种非常间接但礼貌的说法，对不起，我不能留下来。

segments.en: I got to go or I can't really talk to you right now.
segments.zh: 我得走了，否则我现在真的不能和你说话。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So if you're at a party, for example, and you're talking to somebody, but you don't really want to talk to them anymore, you could say, it was nice talking to you if you could excuse me.
segments.zh: 比如在聚会上，你在和某人聊天，但你真的不想再聊下去了，你可以说：很抱歉，恕我失陪。

segments.en: It means if I can leave now.
segments.zh: 它的意思是：我现在可以走了吗。

segments.en: Okay, so you can say if you could excuse me or if you would excuse me.
segments.zh: 所以你可以说 if you could excuse me，或者 if you would excuse me。

segments.en: Both forms are pretty much the same.
segments.zh: 两种形式几乎相同。

segments.en: Okay, and what about when she actually is convinced about the magazine?
segments.zh: 好，那当她真的对这本杂志动心时呢？

segments.en: She says, wow, this is nice.
segments.zh: 她说，哇，这很好。

segments.en: Okay, sign me up for both publications.
segments.zh: 好，那这两份刊物都给我订上。

segments.en: Okay, sign me up.
segments.zh: 好吧，给我报名。

segments.en: This means I would like a subscription.
segments.zh: 这意味着我想要订阅。

segments.en: That means I would like you to take my information and I will give you some money.
segments.zh: 这意味着我希望你接受我的信息，我会给你一些钱。

segments.en: But this is also a really nice phrase in English because it means I want to do this.
segments.zh: 但这在英语中也是一个非常好的短语，因为这意味着我想这样做。

segments.en: I'm interested.
segments.zh: 我很感兴趣。

segments.en: So if you would use this in another context, for example, a group of friends are going to the movies.
segments.zh: 因此，如果您在另一个环境中使用它，例如，一群朋友会去看电影。

segments.en: I say, oh, sign me up.
segments.zh: 我说，哦，给我报名。

segments.en: I want to go.
segments.zh: 我想去。

segments.en: I heard that movie was awesome.
segments.zh: 我听说那部电影很棒。

segments.en: Okay, very good.
segments.zh: 好，很好。

segments.en: So sign me up is like include me, I want to go to or I'm part of it, of whatever you're doing.
segments.zh: 所以 sign me up 就相当于算我一个，我想去，或者无论你在做什么，都算我一份。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: Okay, so that's all the phrases we have for you today.
segments.zh: 好的，这就是我们今天为您准备的所有短语。

segments.en: I think they're really good.
segments.zh: 我觉得它们真的很好。

segments.en: They're not specific for this circumstance of getting a subscription.
segments.zh: 它们并不是专门针对订阅这种情况的。

segments.en: As we saw, we can use them in many other situations.
segments.zh: 正如我们所看到的，我们可以在许多其他情况下使用它们。

segments.en: So I think we should go back, listen to the dialogue for the last time and we'll be back to talk a little bit more.
segments.zh: 所以我认为我们应该回去，最后一次听对话，我们会回来多说一点。

segments.en: Good afternoon, ma'am.
segments.zh: 下午好，女士。

segments.en: My name is Mike and I'm selling subscriptions to all sorts of periodicals.
segments.zh: 我的名字是 Mike，我正在销售各种期刊的订阅。

segments.en: No, thank you.
segments.zh: 不用了，谢谢。

segments.en: I'm not interested.
segments.zh: 我没兴趣。

segments.en: Please, ma'am, if you could spare five minutes of your time, I'm sure we could find something that could interest you.
segments.zh: 拜托，女士，如果你能抽出五分钟的时间，我相信我们能找到你感兴趣的东西。

segments.en: I wish I could, but I have to walk the dog and finish cooking.
segments.zh: 我也想听听，但我还得遛狗、把饭做完。

segments.en: So if you'd excuse me.
segments.zh: 所以，不好意思，我得忙去了。

segments.en: We have a great variety of magazines all about cooking.
segments.zh: 我们有很多关于烹饪的杂志。

segments.en: This one, for example, is a bi-monthly publication with recipes from all over the world.
segments.zh: 例如，这是一份双月刊出版物，其中包含来自世界各地的食谱。

segments.en: Wow.
segments.zh: 哇。

segments.en: Well, that would be kind of useful.
segments.zh: 好吧，那会很有用。

segments.en: Do you have any other cooking magazines?
segments.zh: 你有其他烹饪杂志吗？

segments.en: Sure do.
segments.zh: 当然有。

segments.en: This one is a quarterly publication, but each issue has over 200 colored pages of recipes and also many home decorating ideas.
segments.zh: 这一篇是季度出版物，但每期都有 200 多页彩页的食谱和许多家居装饰理念。

segments.en: Wow, this is nice.
segments.zh: 哇，真不错。

segments.en: Okay, sign me up for both publications.
segments.zh: 好，那这两份刊物都给我订上。

segments.en: You mentioned you have a dog.
segments.zh: 你提到你有一只狗。

segments.en: Most pet owners sign up for this weekly newsletter that has information on dog care, pet shops and even pet sitters.
segments.zh: 大多数养宠物的人都会订阅这份每周通讯，里面有养狗知识、宠物店甚至宠物保姆的信息。

segments.en: That's exactly what I needed.
segments.zh: 这正是我所需要的。

segments.en: What else do you have?
segments.zh: 你还有什么？

segments.en: Well, I also have...
segments.zh: 嗯，我还有……

segments.en: All right, so subscriptions, periodicals, all this is very common, as you said, in the United States.
segments.zh: 好吧，正如你所说，在美国订阅、期刊，这一切都很常见。

segments.en: People get them through the mail every month, right?
segments.zh: 人们每个月都通过邮件收到它们，对吧？

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: And I have to say, it's changing now.
segments.zh: 我不得不说，它现在正在改变。

segments.en: You know, we used to get subscriptions at home when I was a kid.
segments.zh: 你知道，当我还是个孩子的时候，我们曾经在家里订阅。

segments.en: We'd have magazine subscriptions and even a newspaper subscription.
segments.zh: 我们会订阅杂志，甚至订阅报纸。

segments.en: But these days, people are doing more and more on the internet.
segments.zh: 但如今，人们在互联网上做的越来越多。

segments.en: So you don't see the guy with the subscriptions coming from, you know, going from door to door to sell you this.
segments.zh: 所以你看不到那个订阅的人，你知道，挨家挨户卖给你这个。

segments.en: You do it yourself on the internet.
segments.zh: 你自己在互联网上做。

segments.en: So it's pretty common that way.
segments.zh: 所以这种方式很常见。

segments.en: Do you have any web subscriptions?
segments.zh: 你有任何网络订阅吗？

segments.en: No, no, no.
segments.zh: 不，不，不。

segments.en: I haven't signed up for any periodicals on the web.
segments.zh: 我还没有在网上订阅任何期刊。

segments.en: I do receive the newspaper every day and that's about it.
segments.zh: 我确实每天都收到报纸，仅此而已。

segments.en: It's kind of hard to receive magazines where we are, but I am a big fan of magazines like National Geographic or Popular Mechanics.
segments.zh: 我们很难在我们所在的地方接收杂志，但我非常喜欢《国家地理》或《大众机械师》等杂志。

segments.en: I had that when I was a kid.
segments.zh: 我小时候就有过。

segments.en: My grandmother would always give us a subscription to National Geographic for Christmas.
segments.zh: 我祖母每到圣诞节都会给我们订一份《国家地理》。

segments.en: It's a very good magazine and it's so colorful, full of pictures and really interesting articles, not only about animals, but about the world in general.
segments.zh: 这是一本非常好的杂志，色彩丰富，充满了图片和非常有趣的文章，不仅是关于动物的，而且是关于整个世界的。

segments.en: So it's really cool.
segments.zh: 所以真的很酷。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: And they always gave you a map that you could take out and open up and it was the best part of the whole magazine.
segments.zh: 他们总是给你一张地图，你可以拿出并打开它，这是整个杂志中最好的部分。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: So actually, I really enjoy having subscriptions to periodicals, magazines, newspapers.
segments.zh: 所以实际上，我真的很喜欢订阅期刊、杂志、报纸。

segments.en: Not a big fan of newsletters or things on the internet.
segments.zh: 不是通讯或互联网上事物的忠实粉丝。

segments.en: I kind of like to hold a magazine or take it with me if I'm on a trip.
segments.zh: 如果我在旅行，我有点喜欢拿着一本杂志或随身携带。

segments.en: Yeah, I totally agree.
segments.zh: 是的，我完全同意。

segments.en: So yeah, but I think many of our listeners may have a subscription to their local newspaper, local magazines, or maybe as you said, internet subscriptions.
segments.zh: 所以是的，但我认为我们的许多听众可能订阅了他们当地的报纸、当地的杂志，或者正如你所说的互联网订阅。

segments.en: I know some people sign up for the Harvard Business Review that's available online or even I think the New York Times has an online platform.
segments.zh: 我知道有些人注册了在线提供的哈佛商业评论，甚至我认为《纽约时报》有一个在线平台。

segments.en: They do.
segments.zh: 确实有。

segments.en: They do.
segments.zh: 确实有。

segments.en: So you should let us know what subscriptions do you have, what periodicals do you like to read.
segments.zh: 因此，您应该让我们知道您有哪些订阅，您喜欢阅读哪些期刊。

segments.en: Our website of course is EnglishPod.com.
segments.zh: 我们的网站当然是 Englishpod.com。

segments.en: You can also purchase a subscription there.
segments.zh: 您也可以在那里购买订阅。

segments.en: We hope to see you on the website and until next time.
segments.zh: 我们希望在网站上见到您，直到下一次。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: Bye.
segments.zh: 再见。
